fullText.simplified:
第12章、三个租客

    家里来了三个租客。他们在客厅里吃饭、喝酒和大声说话，总是很晚才去睡觉。
    现在，客厅是租客们的了。爸爸和妈妈不再在客厅里看电视了，妹妹也不再在客厅里弹钢琴了。每天晚上，他们都安静地留在自己的房间里。
    爸爸对租客们非常客气。早上，他会说：“先生们，早上好！”晚上，他会问：“先生们，晚饭怎么样？满意吗？”他们的晚饭是妈妈做的，租客们会把饭钱和房间的租金一起给爸爸。如果听到租客们说：“好吃！您夫人做的菜真不错！”爸爸就会高兴地说：“你们满意就好。”有时候租客也会说：“今天的菜有点儿奇怪，好像没有昨天的好吃。”这时候，爸爸就会说：“真是对不起，你们没有吃饱吧？现在让我夫人再做些好吃的菜，好吗？”
    这时候的爸爸是个特别会照顾人的爸爸，高尔没有见过这样的爸爸。过去的这些年里，一直都是家人们照顾爸爸，像照顾孩子一样地照顾着他。
    有天晚上，租客们喝完酒，看到了客厅里的钢琴。
    “那是谁的钢琴？谁会弹钢琴？”租客们问。
    “那是我女儿的钢琴。她会弹钢琴，她弹得很好。”爸爸说。
    “真的吗？请她出来给我们弹一弹吧！”
    妹妹被爸爸和妈妈从房间里叫了出来。她坐在钢琴前面，开始弹钢琴。
    热闹的客厅安静了，优美的琴声响起，躺在床下的高尔听到了。
    这是高尔变成甲虫后的三个月里，妹妹第一次弹钢琴。高尔已经很久没有听到妹妹的琴声了。高尔睁开了眼睛，像以前一样，认真地听妹妹弹钢琴。
fullText.traditional:
第12章、三個租客

    家裡來了三個租客。他們在客廳裡吃飯、喝酒和大聲說話，總是很晚才去睡覺。
    現在，客廳是租客們的了。爸爸和媽媽不再在客廳裡看電視了，妹妹也不再在客廳裡彈鋼琴了。每天晚上，他們都安靜地留在自己的房間裡。
    爸爸對租客們非常客氣。早上，他會說：“先生們，早上好！”晚上，他會問：“先生們，晚飯怎麼樣？滿意嗎？”他們的晚飯是媽媽做的，租客們會把飯錢和房間的租金一起給爸爸。如果聽到租客們說：“好吃！您夫人做的菜真不錯！”爸爸就會高興地說：“你們滿意就好。”有時候租客也會說：“今天的菜有點兒奇怪，好像沒有昨天的好吃。”這時候，爸爸就會說：“真是對不起，你們沒有吃飽吧？現在讓我夫人再做些好吃的菜，好嗎？”
    這時候的爸爸是個特別會照顧人的爸爸，高爾沒有見過這樣的爸爸。過去的這些年裡，一直都是家人們照顧爸爸，像照顧孩子一樣地照顧著他。
    有天晚上，租客們喝完酒，看到了客廳裡的鋼琴。
    “那是誰的鋼琴？誰會彈鋼琴？”租客們問。
    “那是我女兒的鋼琴。她會彈鋼琴，她彈得很好。”爸爸說。
    “真的嗎？請她出來給我們彈一彈吧！”
    妹妹被爸爸和媽媽從房間裡叫了出來。她坐在鋼琴前面，開始彈鋼琴。
    熱鬧的客廳安靜了，優美的琴聲響起，躺在床下的高爾聽到了。
    這是高爾變成甲蟲後的三個月裡，妹妹第一次彈鋼琴。高爾已經很久沒有聽到妹妹的琴聲了。高爾睜開了眼睛，像以前一樣，認真地聽妹妹彈鋼琴。

sentences.simplified: 家里来了三个租客。
sentences.traditional: 家裡來了三個租客。
sentences.pinyin: jiā lǐ lái le sān ge zū kè
sentences.english: Three tenants had moved into the house.

sentences.simplified: 他们在客厅里吃饭、喝酒和大声说话，总是很晚才去睡觉。
sentences.traditional: 他們在客廳裡吃飯、喝酒和大聲說話，總是很晚才去睡覺。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zài kè tīng lǐ chī fàn hē jiǔ hé dà shēng shuō huà zǒng shì hěn wǎn cái qù shuì jiào
sentences.english: They ate, drank, and talked loudly in the living room, and always went to bed very late.

sentences.simplified: 现在，客厅是租客们的了。
sentences.traditional: 現在，客廳是租客們的了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài kè tīng shì zū kè men de le
sentences.english: Now, the living room belonged to the tenants.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸和妈妈不再在客厅里看电视了，
sentences.traditional: 爸爸和媽媽不再在客廳裡看電視了，
sentences.pinyin: bà ba hé mā ma bú zài zài kè tīng lǐ kàn diàn shì le
sentences.english: Gao Er’s father and mother no longer watched TV in the living room.

sentences.simplified: 妹妹也不再在客厅里弹钢琴了。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹也不再在客廳裡彈鋼琴了。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei yě bú zài zài kè tīng lǐ tán gāng qín le
sentences.english: His little sister no longer played piano in the living room.

sentences.simplified: 每天晚上，他们都安静地留在自己的房间里。
sentences.traditional: 每天晚上，他們都安靜地留在自己的房間裡。
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān wǎn shang tā men dōu ān jìng de liú zài zì jǐ de fáng jiān lǐ
sentences.english: Every night, they would quietly remain in their own rooms.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸对租客们非常客气。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸對租客們非常客氣。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba duì zū kè men fēi cháng kè qi
sentences.english: Gao Er’s father was very polite to the tenants.

sentences.simplified: 早上，他会说：“先生们，早上好！”
sentences.traditional: 早上，他會說：“先生們，早上好！”
sentences.pinyin: zǎo shang tā huì shuō xiān sheng men zǎo shang hǎo
sentences.english: In the morning, he would say, “Good morning, gentlemen!”

sentences.simplified: 晚上，他会问：“先生们，晚饭怎么样？满意吗？”
sentences.traditional: 晚上，他會問：“先生們，晚飯怎麼樣？滿意嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang tā huì wèn xiān sheng men wǎn fàn zěn me yàng mǎn yì ma
sentences.english: In the evening, he would ask, “Gentlemen, how was dinner? Are you satisfied?”

sentences.simplified: 他们的晚饭是妈妈做的，
sentences.traditional: 他們的晚飯是媽媽做的，
sentences.pinyin: tā men de wǎn fàn shì mā ma zuò de
sentences.english: Their dinner was made by Gao Er’s mother.

sentences.simplified: 租客们会把饭钱和房间的租金一起给爸爸。
sentences.traditional: 租客們會把飯錢和房間的租金一起給爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: zū kè men huì bǎ fàn qián hé fáng jiān de zū jīn yì qǐ gěi bà ba
sentences.english: The tenants would give the money for the meals together along with the rent to Gao Er’s father.

sentences.simplified: 如果听到租客们说：“好吃！您夫人做的菜真不错！”
sentences.traditional: 如果聽到租客們說：“好吃！您夫人做的菜真不錯！”
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ tīng dào zū kè men shuō hǎo chī nín fū rén zuò de cài zhēn bú cuò
sentences.english: If he heard the tenants say, “Delicious! The food your wife made was really good!” ..

sentences.simplified: 爸爸就会高兴地说：“你们满意就好。”
sentences.traditional: 爸爸就會高興地說：“你們滿意就好。”
sentences.pinyin: bà ba jiù huì gāo xìng de shuō nǐ men mǎn yì jiù hǎo
sentences.english: .. Gao Er’s father would happily say, “As long as you’re satisfied.”

sentences.simplified: 有时候租客也会说：“今天的菜有点儿奇怪，好像没有昨天的好吃。”
sentences.traditional: 有時候租客也會說：“今天的菜有點兒奇怪，好像沒有昨天的好吃。”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou zū kè yě huì shuō jīn tiān de cài yǒu diǎn'r qí guài hǎo xiàng méi yǒu zuó tiān de hǎo chī
sentences.english: Sometimes, the tenants would say, “The food today was a bit strange. It didn’t seem as good as yesterday’s.”

sentences.simplified: 这时候，爸爸就会说：“真是对不起，你们没有吃饱吧？
sentences.traditional: 這時候，爸爸就會說：“真是對不起，你們沒有吃飽吧？
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou bà ba jiù huì shuō zhēn shi duì bu qǐ nǐ men méi yǒu chī bǎo ba
sentences.english: At this point, Gao Er’s father would say, “I’m really sorry. I guess you didn’t have enough to eat?

sentences.simplified: 现在让我夫人再做些好吃的菜，好吗？”
sentences.traditional: 現在讓我夫人再做些好吃的菜，好嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài ràng wǒ fū rén zài zuò xiē hǎo chī de cài hǎo ma
sentences.english: I’ll have my wife make some more good food right now. How does that sound?”

sentences.simplified: 这时候的爸爸是个特别会照顾人的爸爸，高尔没有见过这样的爸爸。
sentences.traditional: 這時候的爸爸是個特別會照顧人的爸爸，高爾沒有見過這樣的爸爸。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou de bà ba shì ge tè bié huì zhào gù rén de bà ba gāo ěr méi yǒu jiàn guò zhè yàng de bà ba
sentences.english: In that moment, Gao Er’s father was a very caring father. Gao Er had never seen his father like this before.

sentences.simplified: 过去的这些年里，一直都是家人们照顾爸爸，像照顾孩子一样地照顾着他。
sentences.traditional: 過去的這些年裡，一直都是家人們照顧爸爸，像照顧孩子一樣地照顧著他。
sentences.pinyin: guò qù de zhè xiē nián lǐ yì zhí dōu shì jiā rén men zhào gù bà ba xiàng zhào gù hái zi yí yàng de zhào gù zhe tā
sentences.english: Over the past few years, it had always been the family taking care of Gao Er’s father, taking care of him like they would a child.

sentences.simplified: 有天晚上，租客们喝完酒，看到了客厅里的钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 有天晚上，租客們喝完酒，看到了客廳裡的鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu tiān wǎn shang zū kè men hē wán jiǔ kàn dào le kè tīng lǐ de gāng qín
sentences.english: One evening, after the tenants had finished drinking, they noticed the piano in the living room.

sentences.simplified: “那是谁的钢琴？谁会弹钢琴？”租客们问。
sentences.traditional: “那是誰的鋼琴？誰會彈鋼琴？”租客們問。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì shéi de gāng qín shéi huì tán gāng qín zū kè men wèn
sentences.english: “Whose piano is that? Who knows how to play the piano?” the tenants asked.

sentences.simplified: “那是我女儿的钢琴。她会弹钢琴，她弹得很好。”爸爸说。
sentences.traditional: “那是我女兒的鋼琴。她會彈鋼琴，她彈得很好。”爸爸說。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì wǒ nǚ ér de gāng qín tā huì tán gāng qín tā tán de hěn hǎo bà ba shuō
sentences.english: “That is my daughter’s piano. She can play the piano, and she plays it very well,” Gao Er’s father said.

sentences.simplified: “真的吗？请她出来给我们弹一弹吧！”
sentences.traditional: “真的嗎？請她出來給我們彈一彈吧！”
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de ma qǐng tā chū lái gěi wǒ men tán yì tán ba
sentences.english: “Really? Have her come out and play a bit for us!”

sentences.simplified: 妹妹被爸爸和妈妈从房间里叫了出来。
sentences.traditional: 妹妹被爸爸和媽媽從房間裡叫了出來。
sentences.pinyin: mèi mei bèi bà ba hé mā ma cóng fáng jiān lǐ jiào le chu lai
sentences.english: Gao Er’s little sister was called out of her room by her father and mother.

sentences.simplified: 她坐在钢琴前面，开始弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 她坐在鋼琴前面，開始彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò zài gāng qín qián miàn kāi shǐ tán gāng qín
sentences.english: She sat in front of the piano and began to play.

sentences.simplified: 热闹的客厅安静了，
sentences.traditional: 熱鬧的客廳安靜了，
sentences.pinyin: rè nao de kè tīng ān jìng le
sentences.english: The lively, noisy living room quieted down.

sentences.simplified: 优美的琴声响起，躺在床下的高尔听到了。
sentences.traditional: 優美的琴聲響起，躺在床下的高爾聽到了。
sentences.pinyin: yōu měi de qín shēng xiǎng qǐ tǎng zài chuáng xià de gāo ěr tīng dào le
sentences.english: The beautiful sound of the piano began to play, and Gao Er, who was lying under the bed, heard it.

sentences.simplified: 这是高尔变成甲虫后的三个月里，妹妹第一次弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 這是高爾變成甲蟲後的三個月裡，妹妹第一次彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì gāo ěr biàn chéng jiǎ chóng hòu de sān ge yuè lǐ mèi mei dì yī cì tán gāng qín
sentences.english: This was the first time his little sister had played the piano in the three months after Gao Er turned into a beetle.

sentences.simplified: 高尔已经很久没有听到妹妹的琴声了。
sentences.traditional: 高爾已經很久沒有聽到妹妹的琴聲了。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr yǐ jīng hěn jiǔ méi yǒu tīng dào mèi mei de qín shēng le
sentences.english: Gao Er hadn’t heard his little sister play the piano in a long time.

sentences.simplified: 高尔睁开了眼睛，像以前一样，认真地听妹妹弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 高爾睜開了眼睛，像以前一樣，認真地聽妹妹彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr zhēng kāi le yǎn jing xiàng yǐ qián yí yàng rèn zhēn de tīng mèi mei tán gāng qín
sentences.english: Gao Er opened his eyes, just like before, listening attentively to his little sister playing the piano.

sentence_translations: Chapter 12: Three Tenants
Three tenants had moved into the house.
They ate, drank, and talked loudly in the living room, and always went to bed very late.
Now, the living room belonged to the tenants.
Gao Er’s father and mother no longer watched TV in the living room.
His little sister no longer played piano in the living room.
Every night, they would quietly remain in their own rooms.
Gao Er’s father was very polite to the tenants.
In the morning, he would say, “Good morning, gentlemen!”
In the evening, he would ask, “Gentlemen, how was dinner? Are you satisfied?”
Their dinner was made by Gao Er’s mother.
The tenants would give the money for the meals together along with the rent to Gao Er’s father.
If he heard the tenants say, “Delicious! The food your wife made was really good!” ..
.. Gao Er’s father would happily say, “As long as you’re satisfied.”
Sometimes, the tenants would say, “The food today was a bit strange. It didn’t seem as good as yesterday’s.”
At this point, Gao Er’s father would say, “I’m really sorry. I guess you didn’t have enough to eat?
I’ll have my wife make some more good food right now. How does that sound?”
In that moment, Gao Er’s father was a very caring father. Gao Er had never seen his father like this before.
Over the past few years, it had always been the family taking care of Gao Er’s father, taking care of him like they would a child.
One evening, after the tenants had finished drinking, they noticed the piano in the living room.
“Whose piano is that? Who knows how to play the piano?” the tenants asked.
“That is my daughter’s piano. She can play the piano, and she plays it very well,” Gao Er’s father said.
“Really? Have her come out and play a bit for us!”
Gao Er’s little sister was called out of her room by her father and mother.
She sat in front of the piano and began to play.
The lively, noisy living room quieted down.
The beautiful sound of the piano began to play, and Gao Er, who was lying under the bed, heard it.
This was the first time his little sister had played the piano in the three months after Gao Er turned into a beetle.
Gao Er hadn’t heard his little sister play the piano in a long time.
Gao Er opened his eyes, just like before, listening attentively to his little sister playing the piano.
